The commission

One image to carry the investigation.

I designed the TX poster for The Real Hack, Five Mile Films’ documentary for ITV1 and ITVX. The work brings its principal figures together through layered monochrome portraits, a worn surface and a direct red title block.

The composition gives the people room to hold the image, while the title stays legible at a glance. Open the poster above to inspect the artwork at full size.
